title: Black Bean Bowl with Roasted Kissed Sweet Potatoes
description: A hearty and flavorful black bean bowl topped with roasted kissed sweet potatoes, finished with a drizzle of venezuelan spices.

ingredients.name: venezuelan spices
ingredients.notes: such as cumin, oregano, and chili powder

instructions: Toss sweet potatoes and red onion with oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
Cook black beans according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine cooked black beans, roasted sweet potatoes and red onion, cilantro, lime juice, and venezuelan spices. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot in a large bowl.
